prior_source: R15 59 eligible development formulas, R15 model frozen independently of any R16 formula
trained_model_algo: ridge-linear, population-standardized clip z to [-3,3]; 25 trajectory features; coefficients for forced 2048/50 only
logic: if n>=220, 4 complete checkpoints, predicted log monitor/forced50 > selected threshold => kissat_set_option(restartint,50) at conflict 2048, else abstain
primary_endpoint: New R16 random3_test (60 distinct new formulas x 3 repeats), live r16_live50 vs same-compiled-binary monitor with PAR2 wall time, paired formula-bootstrap 95% CI, effect/regressions and deployment overhead
secondary_endpoints: prediction vs Python parity within 1e-6 of live score
SAT witness validation, UNSAT independent proof limitations
rule_selection: Thresholds fixed using R15 development observations and conservative design. R15 holdout results are historical hypothesis generation only; no R16 result to tune thresholds. Strict and snapshot are predeclared secondary comparisons.
caveat: R15 coefficients remain fixed in R16. Score calculated in native Kissat during solving, not borrowed from a second monitor run. Only prospective synthetic formulas can validate limited domain. No general SAT or official world record claim.
